children: On September 17, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that its common stock failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days, breaching Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). Filana Therapeutics has 180 days, until March 16, 2027, to regain compliance by achieving a $1.00 closing bid for at least 10 consecutive business days, with a possible second 180-day period. Trading continues on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol FLNA.
